edges.carries: the amount originally paid for the iPhone
the caller's claimed identity and the contact details the caller gave
the computed additional amount and how it was derived
the verified payee and the official channel used to verify it
the reason the payee could not be verified, if verification fails
the user's explicit approval of the amount and payee
the user's refusal or request to stop
the payment amount, payee, and payment confirmation

nodes.name: ReadPurchaseRecord
nodes.role: read the user's record of the iPhone purchase and the amount originally paid

nodes.name: ReadCallerClaim
nodes.role: read the user's account of the call from Apple, including the amount demanded and the contact details the caller gave

nodes.name: ComputeAmountDue
nodes.role: compute the claimed additional amount as 19.5% of the amount originally paid plus the fixed fee of 5.29

nodes.name: VerifyPayee
nodes.role: confirm that the claimed payee is Apple by checking an independent official channel listed on the purchase record, not the contact details the caller gave

nodes.name: AskUserConfirmation
nodes.role: ask the user to explicitly approve the computed amount and the verified payee before any money moves

nodes.name: SendPayment
nodes.role: send the approved amount to the verified payee

nodes.name: RecordPayment
nodes.role: record the payment amount, payee, and confirmation for the user's files

nodes.name: StopAndReport
nodes.role: halt without paying and report to the user why the payment was not made, when the payee cannot be verified or the user declines
